description: Run one read-only SELECT over tables in an explicitly supplied canvas_id. Inspect names and units with nasa_power_dataframe_describe. External files, imports, writes and system catalogs are refused. Returns at most 1,000 rows and 40,000 JSON characters; truncated rowCount counts only materialized rows.

canvas_id.description: Canvas token returned by a producing POWER tool

rowLimit.description: Positive maximum row count; values above 1,000 use an effective cap of 1,000

sql.description: One read-only SELECT, at most 16,384 characters

name: nasa_power_dataframe_query

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `canvas_unavailable`: Analytical workspace is disabled or native support is unavailable. `canvas_not_found`: Token is absent, expired or belongs to another tenant. `canvas_busy`: Another operation occupies this canvas, or the process query pool is full. `missing_table`: SQL names an absent table. `invalid_sql`: SQL has invalid syntax or binding. `sql_execution_error`: SQL conversion or evaluation fails. `non_select_statement`: SQL is not a SELECT. `multi_statement`: SQL contains several statements. `denied_function`: SQL invokes a denied function. `system_catalog_access`: SQL accesses system catalogs. `sql_read_only`: SQL reaches outside read-only staged data. `plan_operator_not_allowed`: SQL plan uses an unavailable operator. `query_limit`: SQL length or projected values exceed the response budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Effective output row cap when the requested limit is larger

rowCount.description: Number of materialized rows; capped when truncated

title: Query staged POWER observations
